name: Google Vertex AI
label: Google Vertex AI
description: Official Vertex AI / Agent Platform REST v1 on aiplatform.googleapis.com (INPUT llm_input → OUTPUT llm_output). operation selects generateContent, embedContent, or Predict. Auth is operator-supplied OAuth access_token (Bearer). OfficialApiNode cannot sign service-account JSON. Image/video/PDF use type file (platform ref-id). Docs: https://cloud.google.com/vertex-ai/docs/reference/rest/v1/projects.locations.publishers.models/generateContent. Terms: https://cloud.google.com/terms. Never log access_token.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: llm_input
ports.description: v2 LLM request so this node can sit on the AI Agent model FUNCTION port. Shape: {messages, contents?, tools?, instances?, parameters?, file?}. Multimodal parts use type file (platform ref-id) or gs:// URIs. Do not put access_token here.

schema.label: messages
schema.description: Conversation for operation=chat. Vertex REST field is contents (role user|model). OfficialApiNode does not remap. Example: [{"role":"user","content":"Hello"}].

schema.label: contents
schema.description: GenerateContentRequest.contents for a faithful REST body.

schema.label: tools
schema.description: Optional function declarations. Omit or [] sends no tools.

schema.label: instances
schema.description: PredictRequest.instances for operation=predict. No raw file bytes — text or gs:// URIs.

schema.label: file
schema.description: Platform file ref-id for multimodal generateContent parts. Never inline bytes.

schema.label: inputFiles
schema.description: user-uploaded files and voice clips for the model

children.label: kind
children.description: File kind: image, document, audio, or video.

children.label: mime_type
children.description: RFC 1521 media type, e.g. application/pdf, image/png

children.label: source
children.description: How the payload is carried: base64 or url.

children.label: data
children.description: base64-encoded payload (when source=base64) or absolute URL (when source=url)

children.label: name
children.description: Original filename, surfaced as the upload name

schema.label: embedContentConfig
schema.description: Embedding options object for operation embeddings, sent as body field embedContentConfig (replaces the deprecated top-level taskType / title / outputDimensionality). Keys: taskType (RETRIEVAL_QUERY | RETRIEVAL_DOCUMENT | SEMANTIC_SIMILARITY | CLASSIFICATION | CLUSTERING | QUESTION_ANSWERING | FACT_VERIFICATION | CODE_RETRIEVAL_QUERY), title (only with RETRIEVAL_DOCUMENT), outputDimensionality (integer), autoTruncate (boolean). Example: {"taskType":"RETRIEVAL_DOCUMENT","title":"Handbook","outputDimensionality":768}.

ports.name: llm_output
ports.description: v2 LLM response envelope. Success includes status/data from OfficialApiNode. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: status
schema.description: ok on HTTP 2xx. Absent on failure.

schema.label: data
schema.description: Parsed Vertex JSON (GenerateContentResponse, EmbedContentResponse, or PredictResponse).

schema.label: outputFiles
schema.description: files produced by the model, e.g. generated images/audio

children.label: kind
children.description: File kind: image, document, audio, or video.

children.label: mime_type
children.description: RFC 1521 media type, e.g. application/pdf, image/png

children.label: source
children.description: How the payload is carried: base64 or url.

children.label: data
children.description: base64-encoded payload (when source=base64) or absolute URL (when source=url)

children.label: name
children.description: Original filename, surfaced as the upload name

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Official Vertex verb. EXACT values: chat | embeddings | predict. Default chat = POST …/models/{model}:generateContent.

configurationParameters.label: Access token
configurationParameters.description: GCP OAuth 2.0 access token (cloud-platform). Sent as Authorization Bearer. Mint with gcloud or your SA outside this node — OfficialApiNode cannot sign service-account JSON. Never logged. Empty → error 'access_token is required'.

configurationParameters.label: Project
configurationParameters.description: GCP project id (path). Required for every operation.

configurationParameters.label: Location
configurationParameters.description: Region in the resource path (e.g. us-central1). Must match model availability.

configurationParameters.label: Publisher
configurationParameters.description: Path publishers/{publisher}. Default google.

configurationParameters.label: Model
configurationParameters.description: Model id without publishers/ prefix. Default gemini-3.7-flash (current Vertex / Agent Platform Flash). Same Gemini 3.x ids as the Gemini API: gemini-3.7-flash, gemini-3.6-flash, gemini-3.5-flash, gemini-3.5-flash-lite, gemini-3.1-pro-preview. gemini-2.5-flash / gemini-2.5-pro retire 2026-10-20. Verify live Model Garden list. Docs: https://docs.cloud.google.com/gemini-enterprise-agent-platform/resources/locations .

configurationParameters.label: Generationconfig
configurationParameters.description: Request-body parameter `generationConfig` for operation: chat.

configurationParameters.label: Messages
configurationParameters.description: Conversation for operation=chat. Vertex REST field is contents (role user|model). OfficialApiNode does not remap. Example: [{"role":"user","content":"Hello"}].

configurationParameters.label: Cachedcontent
configurationParameters.description: Request-body parameter `cachedContent` for operation: chat.

configurationParameters.label: Contents
configurationParameters.description: GenerateContentRequest.contents for a faithful REST body.

configurationParameters.label: Systeminstruction

configurationParameters.label: Tools

configurationParameters.label: Safetysettings

configurationParameters.label: Toolconfig
configurationParameters.description: Request-body parameter `toolConfig` for operation: chat.

configurationParameters.label: Labels

configurationParameters.label: Embedcontentconfig
configurationParameters.description: Embedding options object for operation embeddings, sent as body field embedContentConfig (replaces the deprecated top-level taskType / title / outputDimensionality). Keys: taskType (RETRIEVAL_QUERY | RETRIEVAL_DOCUMENT | SEMANTIC_SIMILARITY | CLASSIFICATION | CLUSTERING | QUESTION_ANSWERING | FACT_VERIFICATION | CODE_RETRIEVAL_QUERY), title (only with RETRIEVAL_DOCUMENT), outputDimensionality (integer), autoTruncate (boolean). Example: {"taskType":"RETRIEVAL_DOCUMENT","title":"Handbook","outputDimensionality":768}.

configurationParameters.label: Content
configurationParameters.description: Request-body parameter `content` for operation: embeddings.

configurationParameters.label: Instances
configurationParameters.description: PredictRequest.instances for operation=predict. No raw file bytes — text or gs:// URIs.

configurationParameters.label: Parameters
configurationParameters.description: Request-body parameter `parameters` for operation: predict.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout (seconds)
configurationParameters.description: HTTP timeout. Default 300. Floor 1.

configurationParameters.label: Stream
configurationParameters.description: Purpose: controls whether Google Vertex AI requests a streamed completion and fans live deltas through helper emitPartial. Canonical flag. When true the node POSTs stream:true, parses SSE data: lines, emitPartial("thinking", delta) for reasoning/thinking and emitPartial("answer", delta) for content; thoughts also appear on llm_output.result.thoughts / thinking; finish_reason, usage and tool_calls are assembled at the end. Accepted: select true | false. Default: true. Invalid/blank → true. Example: true.
